name: reflectivity_gixos_p08_metrics
purpose: Score suggested metadata against a published SciCat record. Deterministic comparison gates; a judged metric runs beside it and never gates.

deepeval.name: SOTA Task Satisfaction
deepeval.criteria: Determine whether the actual output satisfies the expected output and task constraints.
deepeval.note: judge_model is deliberately unset here - it is a deployment choice, and a bundle that hard-codes a judge is not portable. Free-text fields are the only cases a judge is asked about; every other case is decided by exact comparison.
